title.zh: 有限谐波麦克斯韦动理学色散张量

summary: Assemble the x-z-plane kinetic dielectric tensor, Maxwell dispersion tensor and determinant for a magnetized Maxwellian species mixture using a finite cyclotron-harmonic sum.

identity.relation: SI species equilibrium and one real wave point to a complex kinetic dispersion tensor and determinant
identity.direction: (B0, q_s, m_s, n_s, T_s, f, k_z, k_x, lmx) -> K, D, det(D) and derived scales
identity.definition: omega=2*pi*f; vts=sqrt(2*kB*T_s/m_s); wcs=q_s*B0/m_s; wps2=n_s*q_s^2/(m_s*epsilon0); a_s=kx*sqrt(kB*T_s/m_s)/wcs; b_s=a_s^2; z_n=(omega-n*wcs)/(kz*vts). Sum n=-lmx..lmx with Gamma_n(b), Gamma_prime_n(b) and analytic Z(z_n), weighting each species term by (wps2/omega^2)*z_0*Z(z_n). Assemble the source-convention susceptibility components and K, then subtract the Maxwell curl terms to obtain D and its determinant. K_ij = delta_ij - sigma_ij/(i*omega*epsilon0).
identity.model: Truncated conventional cyclotron-harmonic sum for a homogeneous magnetized Maxwellian species mixture; analytic SciRel Faddeeva Z rather than a finite Weideman implementation
identity.geometry: Uniform background field along z with a real wavevector in the x-z plane; tensor axes are x, y, z
identity.coordinates: Signed B0 and charges; kx perpendicular, kz parallel; frequency f is in Hz and omega in rad/s
identity.boundary: Nonzero B0, f, kz and kx are required; all derived terms and the final tensors/determinant must be finite and representable. The harmonic cutoff is finite and caller-selected.
assumptions: Each species has a Maxwellian equilibrium with positive mass, number density and temperature.
The caller judges whether the chosen lmx gives sufficient harmonic convergence for its case.
A determinant value is not by itself a selected physical mode or a root.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Signed homogeneous background magnetic field along z.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero; boolean and complex inputs are rejected.

inputs.name: qs
inputs.description: Signed charges on the shared species axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero, with the same S as ms, ns0 and Ts0.

inputs.name: Ts0
inputs.description: Species equilibrium temperatures already converted to kelvin.

inputs.name: f
inputs.description: Real wave frequency before angular-frequency conversion.

inputs.name: kz
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero; no silent near-zero replacement.

inputs.name: kx
inputs.description: Wavevector component perpendicular to B0 in the x-z plane.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonzero because terms divide by a_s and b_s; zero is not regularized.

inputs.name: lmx
inputs.constraints: Non-negative integer; booleans, floats and numeric strings are rejected.

outputs.name: K
outputs.description: Kinetic dielectric tensor with source sign convention.
outputs.constraints: Finite; K_yx=-K_xy, K_zy=-K_yz and K_zx=K_xz by assembly.

outputs.name: D
outputs.description: Dispersion tensor after Maxwell curl terms.
outputs.constraints: Finite; D_xx=K_xx-nz^2, D_yy=K_yy-nx^2-nz^2, D_zz=K_zz-nx^2 and D_xz=D_zx=K_xz+nx*nz.

outputs.name: determinant
outputs.constraints: Finite and representable; zero may indicate a candidate mode but no root selection occurs.

outputs.name: vts
outputs.description: Species thermal speeds with sqrt(2) convention.

outputs.name: b
outputs.description: Species dimensionless squared Bessel arguments a_s^2.
outputs.constraints: Finite and positive for accepted nonzero kx.

outputs.name: lmx
outputs.description: Echo of the used harmonic cutoff.

preconditions: All species arrays have a shared nonempty axis and SI units; the temperature input is kelvin, not eV.
The real frequency and wavevector point are nonzero where required and the finite harmonic cutoff is adequate for the caller's target accuracy.
supported: One or more homogeneous magnetized Maxwellian species at a real nonzero frequency and x-z-plane wavevector.
Finite harmonic sums with an explicit non-negative integer cutoff and analytic SciRel Z values.
excluded: kx=0 or kz=0 limits, complex frequency/wavevector, drift, loss-cone or arbitrary velocity distributions.
Automatic harmonic-convergence assessment, source Weideman N=64 exact outputs, near-zero kz substitution, root finding or mode-branch selection.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for nonfinite, boolean, complex or zero scalar fields where prohibited; empty/mismatched/nonfinite species vectors, zero charge, nonpositive mass/density/temperature, or lmx that is not a non-negative integer.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if derived scales become nonfinite or zero where positivity is required, or if special-function contributions, tensors or determinant become nonfinite or unrepresentable; other unexpected NumPy/SciPy errors propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iterative solve occurs. A finite lmx is always evaluated; adequacy of harmonic truncation is not certified.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; tensors and determinant are returned together only after the final finite check.

python.signature: evaluate_kinetic_dispersion_sum(*, B0, qs, ms, ns0, Ts0, f, kz, kx, lmx=5)

example.description: Assemble one single-electron tensor at a declared case point. The Python path runs locally; local execution covers this asset.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import evaluate_kinetic_dispersion_sum
r = evaluate_kinetic_dispersion_sum(B0=1.0, qs=[-1.60217662e-19], ms=[9.1094e-31], ns0=[6.075e19], Ts0=[1000.0 * 1.6022e-19 / 1.38064852e-23], f=175881684853.009 / (2*np.pi), kz=1326.1942478795652, kx=13261.94247879565)
assert r['K'].shape == (3, 3) and r['D'].shape == (3, 3)
assert abs(r['determinant'] - (1184249.3244493124 + 4322451.2861608062j)) < 1e-6
example.expected: Python preflight returned finite 3x3 complex K and D tensors; the determinant was 1184249.3244493138 + 4322451.286160805j. local execution covers this asset.
